## 2. A decisive, but deliberately bounded, obstruction

For every L<h<U, retain all26 original support planes and add only N.x<=h. Let G be any symmetric matrix satisfying max(abs(G_ij-I_ij))<=1/16. Then the resulting uniformly filled body, after any affine map A with A.T A=G, has at least two strict unstable equilibria at its actual affine uniform centroid.

This covers the entire strict offset chamber, not a finite sample. It does not cover another cap direction relative to the original body, arbitrary SPD metrics, or independent retained-support motion.

The certificate uses the midpoint cap's continuation labels, not a potentially changing lexicographic ordering at other offsets. Each retained vertex is constant and each crossing-edge intersection is affine in t=(h-L)/(U-L). The capsule constructs all44 labelled vertex polynomials and all maximal face cycles. Boundary integration gives degree-at-most3 V(t) and degree-at-most4 M(t), and checks their exact midpoint agreement with the independently reconstructed cap mass. All degree3 Bernstein coefficients of V are positive.

For each of the13 outgoing arrows of B=list(range(31)), and the three arrows43->38,43->40,43->42, form the symmetric polynomial matrix

`A_ij(t)=sym((V(t)*v_i(t)-M(t))*(v_j(t)-v_i(t)).T)`.

Each of its six degree5 Bernstein coefficient matrices has strictly negative trace. All96 matrices satisfy trace+(1/16)*sum(abs(entries))<0 exactly. Therefore every specified outgoing mechanical score remains strictly negative throughout the chamber and Gram box. The vertex of largest G-radius within B is a strict U: all neighbours inside B have strictly negative outgoing dot products by positive definiteness, and the certificate handles all neighbours outside B. Vertex43 is separately strict U. This argument allows internal ties and does not turn primitive-zero absence into an unstated hypothesis.

The minimum coefficient ratio -trace/sum(abs(entries)) is approximately.11903058229203314, attained at arrow30->36, coefficient5. Its exact rational value and every matrix are regenerated. This arrow is original physical34->40, owned by retained parent supports8 and14. The nearby elder boundary43->42 is original47->46, owned by supports5 and23. These are concrete coupled-carrier targets, not a claim that moving one of them suffices.
